verdict.rationale: Only indirect evidence supports this story. Lithic acts as an issuing-as-a-service layer: it runs a Lithic KYC process (implied by the KYC_BYO bypass option), handles network filing for chargebacks, and exposes program-level controls and card creation via API. A community comment also credits providers like Lithic with cutting the technology cost of launching card products, though it notes compliance and legal remain a burden. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship or bank-partner documentation, a statement that the platform holds or provides network membership, a description of how program management is handled for the customer, and any documented timeline from signup to first live card.
